$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Now Playing player settings; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: nowPlaying
lists.note: The Now Playing player (Austin's idea, Leo 2026-10-18): on by default, and the user can hide it.

rows.note: On by default. Off: no Now Playing card in the sidebar and no player on the new chat page.

help.text: A player for what is playing, at the bottom of the sidebar and on the new chat page.

lists.name: newTab
lists.note: The New Tab page's Now Playing player (Leo 2026-10-19: "disableable"): on by default; its right-click menu's Hide Now Playing turns it off.

rows.name: newTab
rows.note: On by default. Off: no player on the New Tab page and no space kept for it; the sidebar card stays. sidebar.nowPlaying.enabled off hides both.

title.text: Show Now Playing on New Tab

help.text: A player for what is playing, on the New Tab page. Turning off Show Now Playing hides it too.
